focus: Pi OAuth auth-file path canonicalization and write serialization
instruction: Review the current working tree for the Pi OAuth credential-store auth-file queue fix. Focus on packages/agent-runtime/src/pi-auth.js and packages/agent-runtime/src/__tests__/pi-auth.test.js. Determine whether the remaining medium issue from the prior re-review is closed: same-file path aliases such as relative and absolute auth.json paths must use the same in-process queue and avoid lost writes across providers. Also check that the canonicalization does not break missing-file behavior, protected writes, or generated public API expectations. Do not modify files. Report actionable remaining issues only.
